en: Black‑and‑white postcard view through an arched gateway into a cobbled castle courtyard. The sides are framed by high, somewhat weathered masonry walls covered with vines and old windows. At the far end stands a multi‑windowed residential wing with a central passageway arch and a distinctive small baroque tower or cupola rising from the roof. At the top of the card is printed the caption "Wildenfels — Schloßhof".
